stories.title: Cards rookie Baez first ever with 3 HRs in debut
stories.summary: Cardinals rookie outfielder Joshua Baez set an MLB record with three home runs in the first three plate appearances of his major league career Saturday.

stories.title: Monken thrilled with Watson's 'awesome' 1st half
stories.summary: Quarterback Deshaun Watson, in his first game since the 2024 season, completed 11 of 15 passes for 126 yards and led two scoring drives, the only points for the Cleveland Browns in a 34-10 preseason loss to the Chicago Bears on Saturday at Soldier Field.

stories.title: Giants' Dart 'puzzled' after latest concussion test
stories.summary: Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart said he is 'puzzled' after being checked for a concussion during Saturday's preseason game against the Vikings.

stories.title: Adams carted off in Vikings' preseason debut
stories.summary: Veteran defender Jamal Adams was taken to the locker room on a cart Saturday shortly after his preseason debut with the Vikings

stories.title: Haliburton 'shocked' opener not on national TV
stories.summary: Pacers star Tyrese Haliburton said he was "shocked" to learn his first game back from a torn Achilles tendon would not be nationally televised when the NBA regular-season schedule was released last week.
